hypothesis: Exceptional DLMM economics may concentrate in young, volatile, lower-TVL SOL-paired pools that the current >=$50k TVL execution screen excludes.

entry_context.tvl_definition: USD value of both DLMM reserve vault pre-balances immediately before entry, using point-in-time prices.
entry_context.primary_tvl_source: entry transaction preTokenBalances for both immutable pool reserve vaults
entry_context.fallback_tvl_source: Immediately prior successful finalized pool transaction only (failed signatures may be skipped), within 120 seconds of entry; it must expose both immutable reserve vault pre-balances. Do not skip past a successful intervening pool transaction that lacks both reserves.
entry_context.pool_identity_source: current immutable LbPair mint/vault addresses decoded from the pool account; current balances are never used as historical balances
entry_context.price_source: entry historical event USD/amount when nonzero; a missing side may be inferred from the last 5m OHLCV close at or before entry using Meteora pool price orientation
entry_context.unavailable_rule: If both reserve balances and point-in-time prices cannot be proved, entry TVL is unavailable and the position cannot vote in TVL-stratum comparisons.
entry_context.pool_age: entry blockTime minus Meteora pool created_at; negative or missing values unavailable
entry_context.volatility: population standard deviation of 5m log returns from the 60 minutes strictly before entry; requires at least 3 closes
entry_context.fallback_search_bound: Inspect at most 32 newest pre-entry signatures only to skip failed transactions and identify the immediately prior successful pool transaction.

operator_labels.provisional: same frozen cohort; >=20 measured closed positions, >=3 distinct pools, positive total realized API PnL USD
operator_labels.final: positive after-network-cost operator label from the profitable-operator deep study when available
operator_labels.rule: Report provisional and final separately; do not silently promote provisional to final.

comparisons.primary: Within the same profitable-operator population, compare outcomes across TVL strata.
comparisons.secondary: Cross-classify TVL with pool age and pre-entry volatility.

next_stage.requirement: A lower-TVL prospective rule may be proposed only after the descriptive study is complete and frozen separately before future outcomes.

amendment_history.reason: Tighten entry-TVL fallback before any TVL-stratified outcomes: never skip past a successful intervening pool transaction, because it could mutate reserves.
